manualSteps: Installed the local Agent Handles package dependency.
Applied the coordinator's proposed Vite plugin import and plugins-array patch.
Configured eight N2K wrapper components for deterministic scanning.
Ran the two-phase coding-agent identity and journey pass.
Selected an isolated E2E port and the available system Chromium executable.
Ran adopt verify, which performed the build and two repeat journey runs.
packageChangesRequired: Replace the native-only denominator with definite and review-required JSX/TSX candidates.
Detect dynamic tags, handler-bearing custom components, ARIA roles, tabIndex, keyboard handlers, and clickable table structures.
Add wrapper configuration and require forwarding identities at call sites.
Add interaction fingerprints so deleting an interaction cannot improve coverage.
Add settled runtime reconciliation and durable per-journey observations.
Make adoption resumable and prove Vite 6 wiring with a real build and emitted registry.
scars: The old 99/0 registry was an incomplete predicate baseline, not a denominator.
Dynamic Tag controls and wrapper components were invisible to the old scan.
Conditional and interaction-revealed controls required journey-bound runtime evidence.
Playwright's default port reused an unrelated live app, so acceptance now uses an isolated strict port and fresh per-run evidence.
